title: Migrate to new $gnars
subtitle: Only ETH enters the migration. Sell what you hold on the left, deposit on the right.
connectPrompt: Connect your wallet to see your Zora coins and enter the migration.

steps.title: Sell to ETH
steps.body: Each coin is one trade, straight to ETH. ETH already in your wallet needs no trade; old $gnars, ZORA and USDC are rejected on-chain.

steps.title: Deposit
steps.body: Your ETH is held under your own address in the UpgraderEth contract. Withdraw is your exit until the operator runs the launch, and no close date has been announced.

steps.title: Claim at launch
steps.body: One batch buy at a single shared price. Your share of the deposits is your share of the new $gnars, claimed here.

guide.footnote: Launch terms are set by the operator (Onchain Inc / kompreni) and are not readable from the contract, so we don't show them here; they will be published in the launch announcement. Estimates depend on live liquidity and can change; always verify links in official Gnars channels.

noCoins: No migratable Zora coins found in this wallet.
holdingsError: Couldn't load your Zora coins. Nothing is assumed. Try again.
safetyHint: Only verified Zora coins are shown; non-Zora and scam/airdrop tokens are filtered out.

route.hopHint: Each coin routes through its pool pairing into ETH. One trade per coin; these are the hops under the hood.

preview.slippageNote: Thin pools move the price on large sells; the estimate can change before the transaction confirms.
preview.slippageDetails: Each coin gets its own slippage margin, 0.5% to 5%, set from how much its route moves when it is sold in full.
preview.leftoverNote: The deposit is each route's guaranteed minimum; anything above it stays in your wallet as ETH.
preview.batchNote: One signature: every sell and the deposit run as a single sponsored transaction.
preview.sequentialNote: Your wallet may ask for up to {count} signatures (approve, permit and swap per coin, then the deposit), and you pay the gas. Between the sells and the deposit the ETH sits in your wallet, and the deposit is its own transaction.
preview.quoteFailed: {count} quotes failed. The quote service did not answer; the coins are marked in the list.
preview.depositFailedAfterSells: The sells went through but the deposit did not. About {amount} ETH from them is in your wallet; deposit it from the terminal below.
preview.batchNoteSellOnly: One signature: every sell runs as a single sponsored transaction.
preview.sequentialNoteSellOnly: Your wallet may ask for up to {count} signatures (approve, permit and swap per coin), and you pay the gas.
preview.viaKyber: {count} of these coins Zora could not route; KyberSwap can, and will be used for them.
preview.sellOnlyLink: Sell to ETH only, keep it in the wallet

deposit.gatedHint: The deposit terminal turns on here once the contract and upgrade id are confirmed. Sell to ETH now if you want to be ready; the ETH stays in your wallet until then.
deposit.configError: The deposit terminal is misconfigured and has been disabled: {error}
deposit.readError: Couldn't read your deposit from the contract. Nothing is assumed: your deposit is not shown as zero.
deposit.withdrawHint: You are acting as {address}, and withdraw returns ETH to this same address. It works until the operator runs the launch, not after, and withdraw and claim need the same mode you deposited in.
deposit.ownerNote: The contract is operated by Onchain Inc (kompreni), not by the Gnars DAO. Its owner can halt deposits and move tokens out of the contract. Withdraw is the exit you control.
deposit.otherAddressDeposit: You have {amount} ETH deposited from your other address ({address}).
deposit.otherAddressClaim: Your other address ({address}) has new $gnars to claim.
deposit.otherAddressHint: Withdraw and claim must be signed by the address that deposited. Open the wallet menu and press "{button}" to act as {mode}.
deposit.ethElsewhere: This smart account holds no ETH. Your ETH is in your admin address ({address}); open the wallet menu and press "{button}" to deposit from it, or send ETH to this account first.
deposit.liveHint: no close date, can end any time
deposit.gasReserveHint: A gas reserve of {amount} ETH is kept in your wallet.

oldGnars.title: Old $gnars
oldGnars.body: Not accepted. Sells through a thin pool.
oldGnars.impactHint: Price impact is the cost of this sale's size: how much worse the price is versus selling a small amount.
oldGnars.include: Sell my old $gnars to ETH along with the coins below
oldGnars.exceedsBalance: That is more than you hold; the estimate is capped at your balance.
oldGnars.holdBody: Or hold it and do nothing: it stays a tradable Zora creator coin, it just does not enter the migration.
oldGnars.balanceError: Couldn't read your old $gnars balance. Nothing is assumed. Try again.

toasts.cancelled: Cancelled in your wallet, nothing was sent
